class.name: SourceAnimPlayer
class.brief_description: Plays Source MDL animation sequences directly onto a Skeleton3D.
class.description: [SourceAnimPlayer] is a runtime-focused companion to [SourcePPMDL]. It loads an MDL, resolves the required VTX and VVD companions, samples Source animation data, evaluates sequence blend grids, and writes the resulting local bone poses onto a target [Skeleton3D]. The node can target a [Skeleton3D] through [member skeleton_path] or by being parented under one directly. It evaluates parsed sequence autolayers, model autoplay sequences, autoplay IK locks, and local hierarchy overrides so more of Source's sequence dependency graph can run at runtime instead of being baked into a Godot [Animation]. When [member ik_enabled] is [code]true[/code], parsed Source [code]ikchain[/code] and sequence [code]iklock[/code] data are applied as a post-pass using internal Godot IK modifier nodes under the target skeleton. This preserves locked end-effectors and bend direction more faithfully than the base sampled animation alone. Disk-based loads resolve companion external animation blocks automatically when the model references them, and [method open_from_buffer] can accept the same [code].ani[/code] blob explicitly. Pose-parameter-driven autolayers are currently driven from [member blend_values], so more exotic Source control setups such as bone controllers still need follow-up work.

method.name: advance
method.description: Advances playback manually by [param delta] seconds and reapplies the current pose.

method.name: close
method.description: Releases the currently loaded MDL model and clears cached sampled animations.

method.name: find_sequence
method.description: Returns the first sequence index whose label matches [param name], or [code]-1[/code] if none was found.

method.name: get_mdl_path
method.description: Returns the last opened MDL path, or an empty string if the model was loaded from memory.

method.name: get_sequence_count
method.description: Returns the number of parsed sequence descriptors.

method.name: get_sequence_names
method.description: Returns the sequence labels in descriptor order.

method.name: get_vtx_path
method.description: Returns the last opened VTX companion path, or an empty string if the model was loaded from memory.

method.name: get_vvd_path
method.description: Returns the last opened VVD companion path, or an empty string if the model was loaded from memory.

method.name: has_sequence
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a sequence with the requested label exists.

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a model is currently loaded.

method.name: is_playing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the node is advancing playback automatically.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens an MDL from disk. If [param vtx_path] or [param vvd_path] are omitted, common companion filenames are resolved next to the MDL automatically.

method.name: open_from_buffer
method.description: Opens an MDL triplet from memory buffers. If the model references external Source animation blocks, pass the companion [code].ani[/code] blob in [param anim_block_data].

method.name: play
method.description: Starts playback of the currently selected sequence from [param from_time] seconds.

method.name: play_sequence
method.description: Selects a sequence descriptor and starts playback from [param from_time] seconds.

method.name: play_sequence_by_name
method.description: Finds a sequence by label and starts playback from [param from_time] seconds.

method.name: seek
method.description: Moves playback to [param time] seconds. If [param update] is [code]true[/code], the pose is applied immediately.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops automatic playback. If [param reset] is [code]true[/code], mapped bones are reset back to the skeleton pose instead of holding the current sampled pose.

members.member: Blend values used for sequence grid selection and the first layer of pose-parameter-driven autolayers.
If [code]true[/code], parsed Source IK chains and sequence IK locks are applied after the sampled animation pose is written to the target skeleton.
Path to the target [Skeleton3D]. If empty, the node tries to use its parent as the skeleton target.

signal.name: sequence_event
signal.description: Emitted when playback crosses a parsed sequence event.

signal.name: sequence_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a non-looping sequence reaches the end of playback.
